paragraphs.text: I am applying for the full-stack developer role at Example Analytics. Building internal reporting tools on PostgreSQL and TypeScript is close to the work I did at Example Workshop, where I built a reporting tool that reduced weekly report preparation from four hours to one.

On the Community Tool Library I implemented keyboard-accessible forms for recording tool loans and documented the local development setup for a volunteer team, which is the kind of care internal tools deserve.
I would welcome a conversation about how I could help your team.
